title: permanent_bipedal5 implementation
description:
Implement `permanent_bipedal5` over the F_5 packed type (T17), using `gray_code_iter` (T6) and `Packed5Vec::fold_mul`.

## Background

Mirrors the F_3 path: walk Gray-code subset order, update the packed column-sum vector by a single `Packed5::add`/`sub` per step, fold via the F_5 multiplication tree at each step. The function lives in `gf2-algebra::permanent::permanent_bipedal5`.

The lane-count of `Packed5` (chosen by R1) determines the matrix-size limit before multi-word streaming kicks in. Document that limit clearly.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `gf2-algebra::permanent::permanent_bipedal5(matrix: &Packed5Matrix) -> Fp<5>` exists.
- [ ] [hard] Matrix-size upper bound for the single-word path is documented in the function doc-comment, and matches `Packed5::LANES`.
- [ ] [hard] Output bit-identical to `permanent_ryser<Fp<5>>` (T7) on 1000 random matrices for each $n \in \{1, \ldots, 14\}$ — covers epic success criterion 6.
- [ ] [hard] No `unsafe` in the gf2-algebra path.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-algebra --release --profile ci` passes.
